zh.line1: AI 已经学会回答问题，
zh.lede: 我们让真实的科学问题、数据与实验反馈进入下一代 AI 系统，探索从辅助科研到参与科学发现的路径。
zh.loop_eyebrow: 一个闭环，不是一条直线
zh.loop_left: 系统不再只接受一个已经定义好的问题，而是从一个尚未充分理解的世界出发，识别值得研究的未知。
zh.loop_right: 假设不停留在文本里。系统调用工具、数据与实验环境去执行，并接受外部证据的检验。
zh.return_label: 验证结果更新对世界的理解

三个独立工作连续发布
zh.foot: PhAI Labs · 面向真实科学发现的模型与数据基础设施

en.line1: AI has learned to answer questions.
en.lede: We bring real scientific questions, data and experimental feedback into next-generation AI systems, on a path from assisting research to taking part in discovery.
en.loop_left: The system no longer takes a problem as given. It starts from a partially understood world and identifies the unknowns worth research.
en.loop_right: A hypothesis does not stay on paper. The system calls tools, data and experimental environments, and submits to external evidence.
en.return_label: Validated findings update the world model
facts: DFM technical report and research map
Three independent works, one a day
en.foot: PhAI Labs · Model and data infrastructure for real scientific discovery
